## What Changed

Describe the behavior changed and link the issue, if any.

## Verification

List commands/results, actual app screenshots for UI changes, and device/OS details.
Separate automated checks from physical-device testing. State what remains unverified.

## Checklist

- [ ] Focused change with relevant regression tests.
- [ ] Package/helper tests and affected native build/tests run, or limitations explained.
- [ ] No private audio, transcripts, credentials, signing files, or model caches.
- [ ] On-device privacy, permission boundaries, and third-party attribution preserved.
- [ ] Production identities, signing settings, updater configuration, and release numbers unchanged.
- [ ] Accessibility and both appearances considered for UI changes.
